result.title: Inherited Adapter Experts for Replay-Free Domain-Incremental Learning
result.comment: 21 pages (8 pages main text, plus references and supplementary material), 8 figures, 23 tables
result.summary: Replay-free domain-incremental learning trains a model on the same classes in successive domains without keeping earlier images. Per-domain learners freeze a pre-trained ViT and train an additional expert for each new domain: the small set of parameters and the classification head learned on that domain. Test images carry no domain label, so a router selects one expert for each image. Recent work trains this router. However, a training-free Mahalanobis router costs the analyzed learners under 2.7 points of final accuracy relative to always selecting each image's own-domain expert. The experts, not this router, limit accuracy. Our learner, Lamarck, therefore uses this router and strengthens the experts. Its adapters, small trainable layers that correct every image token after each deep ViT block, add 4.4 points of final accuracy on the deepfake benchmark CDDB-Hard. In addition, each expert is initialized from its predecessor at no extra cost: the domains share their classes, so an image misrouted to a later expert loses less. Against twelve frozen-backbone baselines under one protocol, Lamarck is first on CDDB-Hard by 5.2 points, second on DomainNet and OfficeHome, and highest in mean accuracy.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究无回放的域增量学习：冻结预训练 ViT，为每个新域训练由适配器和分类头组成的小型专家，并用免训练的 Mahalanobis router 在无域标签时按图像选专家；作者提出 Lamarck，在深层 ViT 块后用小适配器修正全部图像 token，并把每个专家初始化为上一域专家的参数，在 CDDB-Hard 等基准上超过十二个基线。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「按实例路由选择专家」与「逐层 token 适配器修正、初始化继承前序专家以降低误选代价」可能可供核查 LVR 中 latent 假设/子模块的选择与保持既有能力不遗忘的训练线索，但论文本身不涉及多模态推理。
